title: Flip To Win
summary: An open-source Jetpack Compose library for the "flip a card, win a prize" mechanic, and the real version of the game at the top of this page. The prize is claimed on the backend before any card turns, so the reveal never shows something the server has not confirmed. Clean Architecture, unidirectional data flow and unit-tested state mapping.
imageAlt: Article cover: a card flips over a phone screen to reveal a trophy after a backend claim.
